info.about: Drakengard, known in Japan as Drag-On Dragoon, is a 2003 action role-playing video game developed by Cavia and published by Square Enix for the PlayStation 2. The game is the first installment of the Drakengard series and features a mixture of ground-based hack-and-slash, aerial combat, and role-playing elements which have become a staple of the series.
info.trivia: Director Yoko Taro set the game's dark tone, and references to incest and sexual taboos were censored in the Western localization.
info.why: NieR spun off from this game's fifth ending, and the first Drakengard has had no console release beyond the PS2 disc, so NieR fans looking for its roots buy the original.
